# TwoStack

> AI-native web, mobile, and automation development studio based in Colombo, Sri Lanka. We build the website, the automation layer, and the intelligence layer - as one connected system.

## About

TwoStack is a software development studio that builds complete digital ecosystems for businesses. We combine web development, AI-powered automation, and business intelligence into one unified system - not three separate tools from three separate vendors.

We are based in Colombo, Sri Lanka, and work with startups and businesses worldwide.

## Core Services

### Presence Layer (Web & Mobile Development)
- Marketing websites built to convert
- E-commerce storefronts with payment gateway integration
- Client and customer portals
- Internal tools and admin dashboards
- iOS and Android mobile apps (native and cross-platform)

### Automation Layer (AI & Workflow Automation)
- WhatsApp AI assistants (Sinhala, Tamil, and English)
- Order and workflow tracking
- Automated reminders and follow-ups
- System-to-system sync (CRM, payments, calendar)

### Intelligence Layer (Dashboards & Analytics)
- Real-time business dashboards
- Demand and cash flow forecasting
- Automated weekly and monthly reporting
- Decision flags and anomaly detection

## Tech Stack

Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, AI/ML, Python

## Target Audience

Startups, SMEs, and enterprises looking for custom software development, AI automation, and digital transformation - in Sri Lanka and worldwide.
